column1: # Stage S6 P0c — the cut wave inside the map engine: the chunk scheduler's object index and chunk ingest,
# the building footprint buffers, and the frame's source-text bind pins move to the modules that own them.
# Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the chunk scheduler's object index leaves the spatial indexes for the scheduler that fills it
# chunk ingest into the residency (impl blocks of the scheduler's WorldResidency) joins the scheduler
# the building footprint fill and outline composition joins the draw buffers it writes
# the render-only source-text pins of the frame's bind functions leave the overlay for the frame
